page.overview:
Who is Bren Kingal's sister?

The sister of the Human Rebel Bren Kingal had a secret family recipe for a dessert known as Eopie Cream Pie. Kingal considered his sister's pie the best reward in the city of Mos Taike on the planet Tatooine, gifting one of them to a spacer whom he had kill a local murderer.

Bren Kingal's sister was mentioned in the 2003 Sony Online Entertainment massively multiplayer online role-playing game, Star Wars Galaxies. if the player successfully completed a quest for Bren Kingal called "Mission 4: Trone Thanamiroc," Kingal would mention his sister while distributing an Eopie Cream Pie as a reward.
